panels.title: Desired Replicas
panels.description: Current selected-workload totals. Resources include ordinary containers and currently running init/native sidecars; completed init containers are excluded. These are container totals, not a reconstruction of scheduler init-phase maxima or Pod overhead.

targets.expr: sum((max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",deployment=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",statefulset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",daemonset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) and on (workload_type) label_replace(vector(1), "workload_type", "$workload_type", "", "")))

panels.title: Active workload alerts — all namespaces

panels.title: Active pod issues

sum((max by (cluster, namespace, workload, workload_type) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",deployment=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",statefulset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "statefulset", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace",daemonset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "workload_type", "daemonset", "", "")) and on (workload_type) label_replace(vector(1), "workload_type", "$workload_type", "", "")))
